subject: general
question: Who launched the International Air Connectivity Scheme (IACS) in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jyotiraditya Scindia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• UDAN (Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik) is a regional airport development and “Regional Connectivity Scheme” (RCS) of the Government of India, with the objective of making air travel affordable and widespread, to boost inclusive national economic development, job growth, and air transport infrastructure development of all regions and states of India.
 
• The scheme aims to connect unserved and underserved airports in India through flights with fares capped at ₹2,500 per hour of flight.
 
• The scheme also provides various incentives to airlines such as reduced excise duty, service tax, and value-added tax on aviation turbine fuel (ATF) used for RCS flights.
 
• It has been launched by Jyotiraditya Scindia in 2022.
 
• The scheme has been extended till 2024

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Under the IACS, the government provides financial assistance to airlines operating flights to and from underserved and unserved airports in the country, as well as to airports that have the potential for tourism development.
 
• The scheme is designed to make air travel more affordable for passengers and to promote tourism in different regions of India.
 
• To be eligible for the scheme, airlines must operate flights to and from the selected airports at least twice a week, and offer a minimum of 10% of the total seats on these flights at a discounted rate.
 
• The government provides financial support to airlines in the form of a per-seat subsidy for up to three years, subject to certain conditions.
 
• Overall, the IACS aims to boost economic development in different regions of India by improving air connectivity and increasing tourism.
